title: ELARSpeech: A 30K-Hour Dataset Across 675 Underrepresented Languages for Long-Tail Multilingual Speech Technologies
abstract: arXiv:2610.19388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Massively multilingual speech modeling has made remarkable progress in recent years, yet existing training resources and benchmarks still underrepresent much of the linguistic long tail. To address this gap, we introduce ELARSpeech, a large-scale multilingual speech resource comprising 30,202 hours of speech across 675 underrepresented languages, curated from the Endangered Languages Archive. Combining human-annotated and unlabeled recordings, the corpus spans diverse recording conditions, domains, and language families. Beyond corpus construction, our experiments show how ELARSpeech supports extending ASR and TTS capabilities to diverse underrepresented languages, with further benefits from pseudo-labeling unlabeled data. At the same time, our speech representation analysis reveals remaining limitations in transferring existing multilingual models to the linguistic long tail. translated_title: ELARSpeech：一个覆盖675种代表性不足语言、时长3万小时的长尾多语言语音技术数据集
translated_abstract: 近年来，大规模多语言语音建模取得了显著进展，然而现有的训练资源和基准测试仍然未能充分覆盖语言长尾中的大部分语言。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了ELARSpeech，这是一个大规模多语言语音资源，包含来自675种代表性不足语言的30,202小时语音数据，整理自濒危语言档案馆。该语料库结合了人工标注和未标注的录音，涵盖了多样的录音条件、应用领域和语系。除了语料库构建之外，我们的实验展示了ELARSpeech如何支持将自动语音识别（ASR）和语音合成（TTS）能力扩展到多种代表性不足的语言，并且通过对未标注数据进行伪标注可以带来进一步的收益。与此同时，我们的语音表征分析揭示了将现有多语言模型迁移到语言长尾时仍存在的局限性。总而言之，ELARSpeech既提供了一份宝贵的资源，也提供了一个测试平台。
tldr: ELARSpeech是一个包含675种代表性不足语言、总时长30,202小时的大规模多语言语音数据集，为将语音识别与语音合成技术扩展至语言长尾领域提供了重要资源和测试平台。
en_tdlr: ELARSpeech is a large-scale multilingual speech dataset covering 30,202 hours across 675 underrepresented languages, providing both a valuable resource and a testbed for extending ASR and TTS capabilities to the linguistic long tail.
